items.title: Intuit stock falls on weaker outlook, Mailchimp sale to Bending Spoons
items.summary: Intuit stock is already down more than 50% this year. Now it's falling more as the TurboTax parent cuts its outlook.

items.title: Intuit (INTU) Stock Price Slides As Q1 Results Meet Slower Growth Fears
items.summary: Intuit just released Q1 FY2027 numbers that looked solid on paper, yet the stock still sank about 13% today to roughly US$270. The software group delivered about US$4.4b in revenue and basic earnings per share of about US$2.60, figures that align with a profitable, mature platform rather than a broken story. The key issue is sentiment. Traders are focusing on moderated growth expectations and the pressure from Credit Karma, and that focus is driving the sharp price reset. The question now is...

items.title: Intuit Sinks 13% on Revenue Guidance Cut as CEO Calls AI Tools “New Front Doors for Discovery”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIntuit shares fell 13% after it cut its fiscal 2027 revenue growth guidance to 8%-9%, as Credit Karma’s outlook dropped to 3%-7% growth from 11%-13%. Management blamed higher rates and a faster-than-expected shift to AI tools.
